title: Resolve the CLI operative root from the current repository
objective: Make repository-dependent sdlc commands operate on the Git repository associated with the current working directory instead of the repository that contains the installed CLI, while keeping root resolution behind a replaceable boundary and releasing the change as version 0.2.0.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository is already on the main branch and the user requested preparation, processing, and per-task commits on the current repository.

request.text: Prepare a new .docs/work-items/* to make the sdlc command line tool operate on the Git repository associated with the current working directory rather than assuming the sdlc repository. Encapsulate operative-root resolution for future replacement, add regression coverage, bump the minor package version, commit the work item, then process the new work item and commit per task.

scope.name: operative-root-resolution
scope.description: Resolve the operative repository root from the current working directory by using a dedicated replaceable application boundary.
scope.reason: Repository-dependent commands must target the caller's repository and must not derive operational data from the installed CLI location.

scope.name: repository-command-routing
scope.description: Route work-item, task, reference, and stat commands through the resolved operative root while preserving package metadata lookup and explicit repository-info path behavior.
scope.reason: All repository-dependent command surfaces need consistent root semantics without changing version lookup or explicit path discovery.

scope.name: cwd-regression-coverage
scope.description: Add focused and fresh-process-compatible tests proving commands inspect a separate repository selected by the current working directory, including nested directories and no-repository errors.
scope.reason: The prior hard-coded root behavior can pass tests run from the sdlc repository unless a separate repository is exercised.

scope.name: minor-release
scope.description: Bump the package minor version from 0.1.0 to 0.2.0 and verify the compiled launcher reports the new version.
scope.reason: The user requested a minor release for this behavior change before 1.0.0.

nonGoals.name: repository-selection-options
nonGoals.description: Do not add a new command-line option for overriding the operative repository root.
nonGoals.reason: This change establishes CWD-based default behavior; future override mechanisms can be added independently.

nonGoals.name: package-location-operation
nonGoals.description: Do not use the caller repository to locate the installed package metadata needed by --version.
nonGoals.reason: Version lookup must continue to work when the installed CLI is invoked from any repository or directory.

nonGoals.name: repository-mutation
nonGoals.description: Do not initialize, modify, commit, checkout, or otherwise mutate the caller repository as part of root resolution or command execution.
nonGoals.reason: Operative-root discovery and the affected commands are read-only.

items.name: cwd-operative-root
items.description: Repository-dependent commands must resolve and use the nearest Git repository containing the current working directory rather than the repository containing the installed CLI module.
items.reason: The CLI is intended to work in any repository.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A repository-dependent command invoked from a separate repository reports and reads paths relative to that separate repository.
A command invoked from a nested directory resolves the containing repository root, while a command outside any Git repository returns a stable non-zero error.

items.name: replaceable-root-boundary
items.description: Operative-root resolution must be encapsulated behind a dedicated function or module so a future root-selection policy can replace it without changing every command handler.
items.reason: Root-selection policy is an application concern and should not be coupled to individual command implementations.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Repository-dependent command handlers obtain their repository root through the shared operative-root boundary and do not derive it from the installed module path.

items.name: command-boundary-regression
items.description: Tests must cover operative-root resolution, affected command routing, explicit repository-info behavior, read-only operation, and package-version behavior.
items.reason: The change crosses CLI dispatch, Git discovery, filesystem paths, and package metadata boundaries.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The test suite proves a separate repository is selected from the CWD and confirms inspected files and repository state remain unchanged.
Existing commands and explicit repository info path selection retain their documented behavior.

items.name: minor-release-version
items.description: The package version must be bumped from 0.1.0 to 0.2.0 and the built launcher must report 0.2.0.
items.reason: The user requested a minor version release for the cross-repository CLI behavior change.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Package metadata, version tests, and a fresh compiled CLI invocation consistently report version 0.2.0.
